manifest.description: Required. Always the text `s2u-pack`: it says the file is a v2 pack manifest.
Required. Always the number `2`. Any other value is refused with `pack.FORMAT_VERSION`.

Required. The pack's id: 1 to 64 characters of lower-case `a-z`, `0-9`, dots and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit, with no `..`. It may not begin with `mod.`, `model.` or `texture.`: those prefixes are kept for the earlier formats.
Required. The pack's version, a semantic version such as `1.0.0` (a pre-release such as `1.0.0-beta.1` is allowed here, but not by Thunderstore).
Required. The pack's display name: 1 to 48 printable ASCII characters.
Optional. A short description: up to 400 printable ASCII characters. It is part of the pack's identity hash, so changing it changes the pack's hash.
Required. The disc revision the pack is for. It must be exactly the build's target (see `PACK_TARGET_US` below); an earlier spelling is refused and the finding names the canonical one.

Required. A version range, such as `^0.1.1`, that the build's engine contract version (`ENGINE_CONTRACT_VERSION`) must satisfy. Ranges take `*`, `=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `^` and `~`, sets separated by spaces and alternatives by `||`. A pack of kind `rules` must not admit any engine before `0.1.1`.
Required. A list naming each of `content`, `rules` and `system` at most once, and at least one of them: what the pack contains.
Required. One of `client`, `server` or `both`. The check only tests that it is one of the three; nothing else in the contract reads it. The earlier formats are read as `client`.

Required, empty when there are none. A list of at most 64 entries, each either `{id, range}` (another pack, by its id and a version range) or `{archive, sha256}` (one of your own disc archives, by its path and SHA-256). The same id or archive may not appear twice, and a pack may not depend on itself.

Required, at least one row. Every member of the pack except the manifest itself, one row each (see the `files` row below). A file in the zip that is not listed is refused, apart from Thunderstore's root files beside the manifest.
Required. A list of at most 64 entries, each `{kind, files}`: which members a change is declared to be, and what kind of change it is. Every member must be named by at least one intent.
Optional. A list of at most 32 claims on handler slots the engine owns (see the `handlers` claim below). No pack code runs: a claim only names a handler the engine already has.

fileRow.description: The member's path inside the pack: relative, forward slashes, at most 240 characters and 16 folders deep, with no `..`, drive, leading slash, colon, percent sign, control character, hidden (dot-led) or reserved segment. It may not be `s2u-pack.json` or one of Thunderstore's root files.
The SHA-256 of the member's bytes, as 64 lower-case hex digits. The check hashes the member and refuses it when the hash differs.
The member's size in bytes, a whole number of 0 or more. The check compares it with the stored size before reading any bytes.
What the member is: one of the roles below. The path's file type must be one the role allows.

handlerClaim.description: The engine-owned slot the pack claims, a dotted lower-case name of at most 64 characters such as `visual.post`. A pack claims a slot at most once.

The engine handler the pack asks for on that slot, a dotted lower-case name of at most 64 characters. It must be one the build offers for that slot, or the claim is refused with `pack.HANDLER_UNKNOWN`.
Optional. A list of at most 64 distinct dotted lower-case action names the claim uses; each must be one the handler offers.

Optional. A plain JSON object handed to the handler: at most 4096 bytes of JSON, nested at most 2 deep, finite numbers only, and no `__proto__`, `constructor` or `prototype` key. The contract checks only this shape; the handler checks what is in it.

kinds.description: Content: assets and maps (models, textures, sounds, collision, data, an authored map). The earlier formats are read as `content` packs. The check sets no rule of its own on this kind.

Declarative rules for a game mode, in `rules`-role JSON members: data only, never code. A `rules` pack's `contract` must start at `0.1.1` or above, and its members' capabilities must agree with its `handlers` claims.
Engine systems: changes made through claims on engine-owned handler slots (the one such slot today is the full-screen picture pass `visual.post`). The check sets no rule of its own on this kind.

legacyKinds.description: An `s2u-mod` v1 data-override mod. It is read as the pack `mod.` plus its id, its files as role `data` under a `gameplay-value` intent; a version that is not a semantic version is kept as `0.0.0+legacy.` plus the old version.
The model pack (glTF models in place of the game's meshes). It is read as `model.current` version `1.0.0`, its files as role `mesh` under a `cosmetic` intent.

A texture pack for one map. It is read as `texture.` plus the map's name, version `1.0.0`, its files as role `texture` under a `cosmetic` intent with their own SHA-256 and sizes, and the map archive as a disc archive dependency when the pack records the archive's SHA-256.

sides.description: The value `client`. The check accepts it; the contract gives it no further rule.
The value `server`. The check accepts it; the contract gives it no further rule.
The value `both`. The check accepts it; the contract gives it no further rule.

roles.description: Collision data, as JSON or a glTF binary model.
A JSON member of gameplay values.

A JSON rules member (a rules spec). It is bounded by `PACK_RULES_MEMBER_BYTES_ADAPTATION`, read whole once, and must be a UTF-8 JSON object whose `capabilities`, when present, is a list of `{slot, handler, actions?}`.
A JSON member for a system claim.
Any other data; any file type.
An earlier format's own manifest, kept as a member when the contract reads an earlier pack.

intents.description: The members change only how the game looks or sounds. A `collision`, `gameplay` or `rules` member cannot be covered by `cosmetic` alone.
The members change values the game already has.
The members add behaviour the game does not have.

values.description: The manifest's file name at the pack's root.
The engine contract version this build publishes; a pack's `contract` range must include it.
The disc revision this build targets (the US disc's product code); a pack's `target` must be exactly this.
The first engine contract with the rules vocabulary. A `rules` pack's `contract` must start at it or above in every `||` alternative; it stays the same when the build's contract moves on.
A stand-in for the Thunderstore team packs would publish under, used in exported dependency pins. It is not a real team: the team is not named yet.

targetAliases.description: The `s2u-mod` v1 spelling of the target. Only the `mod` adapter accepts it; in a v2 manifest it is refused and the finding names the canonical target.

bounds.description: All members together, by their sizes in the manifest (`pack.TOO_LARGE`). The stored files are first held to this plus the manifest's own bound.
Files in the pack, and rows in `files` (`pack.TOO_MANY_FILES`).
Bytes of one claim's `options` written as JSON (`pack.FIELD_INVALID`).
How deep one claim's `options` nest: the options object is level 1, an object or list inside it level 2 (`pack.FIELD_INVALID`).
Characters in `id`, not counting an earlier format's prefix (`pack.FIELD_INVALID`).
The size of `s2u-pack.json` (`pack.MANIFEST_TOO_LARGE`), and of Thunderstore's `manifest.json` when the store checker reads it.
One member, other than a `rules` member (`pack.MEMBER_TOO_LARGE`).
One `rules` member, which is read whole (`pack.MEMBER_TOO_LARGE`). It is the manifest's bound.

storeRules.description: The files a Thunderstore package must hold at its root (not in a folder).
The root file a Thunderstore package may also hold.
The keys of Thunderstore's `manifest.json`, in the order the export writes them.
The store name: letters, digits and underscores, at most 128 characters. Our id becomes it with each `.` and `-` written as `_`.
The store version: strictly Major.Minor.Patch, with no pre-release or build part.
The store description's length in characters. The export never cuts a longer one; it refuses it.
The store `website_url`: empty, or an http or https address. This rule is ours, not Thunderstore's; a pack manifest cannot carry an address, so the export takes it as an option.
One store dependency: `Team-Name-x.y.z`, an exact version. The export pins each `{id, range}` dependency to the highest release it is given inside the range.
The size `icon.png` must be, in pixels. Only the PNG header is read.

packCodes.description: The pack has no `s2u-pack.json` and is not being read through an earlier format's loader.
`s2u-pack.json` is over `PACK_MANIFEST_BYTES_ADAPTATION`.
`s2u-pack.json` is not UTF-8 JSON, or is not a JSON object.
An earlier format's manifest is not in that format's shape, or its own path is not a valid member path.
The manifest, or a `files` row, has a field the format does not list.
A field's value breaks its rule: the wrong type, out of its bounds, not one of its allowed values, or a target written in an earlier spelling. Also a stored member whose size is not a byte count.
`formatVersion` is not `2`.
The pack's `target` is not the build's disc revision.
The build's engine contract version is outside the pack's `contract` range.
A path is empty, uses backslashes, is too long or too deep, or has a control character, colon, percent sign, or an empty, hidden, reserved or unsafe segment.
A path is absolute, names a drive, or leaves the pack with `..`.
Two files or rows are the same path once Unicode-normalised and compared without case.
A path is a URI, or a manifest text holds an address such as `https://` or begins with `data:`, `javascript:`, `file:` or a similar scheme. Every byte comes from the pack or your own disc.
The pack holds, or `files` lists, more than `PACK_FILES_ADAPTATION` members.
The members' sizes in the manifest add up to more than `PACK_BYTES_ADAPTATION`, or the stored files add up to more than that plus `PACK_MANIFEST_BYTES_ADAPTATION`.
`dependencies`, `intents` or `handlers` has more entries than its bound.
One member is over its bound (`PACK_MEMBER_BYTES_ADAPTATION`, or `PACK_RULES_MEMBER_BYTES_ADAPTATION` for a `rules` member).
A member has more bytes than its declared size.
A member has fewer bytes than its declared size.
A listed member is not in the pack.
A member's bytes do not match the `sha256` its row names.
A file in the pack is not listed in `files`.
A member's file type is not one its role allows.
No intent names a member.
A `collision`, `gameplay` or `rules` member is covered only by a `cosmetic` intent.
`dependencies` names the same pack or archive twice.
No available pack with that id is inside the range, or the named disc archive is not present.
The disc archive is present but its SHA-256 is not the one the pack names.
The pack depends on itself, directly or through the available packs.
Two claims in the pack are on one slot, or the slot is held by another pack and only one pack may hold it.
The build offers no such handler for that slot.
The claimed handler has no such action.
A `files` row names one of Thunderstore's root files. Leave them out of `files`: they sit at the pack's root outside its identity.
A `rules` pack's `contract` admits an engine before `RULES_PACK_CONTRACT_FLOOR`.
A `rules` member is not a UTF-8 JSON object, or its `capabilities` is not a list of `{slot, handler, actions?}`.
A `rules` member's capabilities and the manifest's `handlers` claims disagree: a capability with no matching claim or action, or a claim on a `behaviour.` slot that no rules member names.

A note, not an error: a check could not run because the build gave it nothing to check against (the available packs, your disc archives or the handler list). The report is then incomplete, never a pass.

storeCodes.description: The team name is not 1 to 128 letters, digits and underscores.
The pack's id has no store name.
Two ids, the pack's own or ones it depends on, would become the same store name. Neither is renamed: one pack has to change its id.
The pack's version is not strictly Major.Minor.Patch (a pre-release or build part).
The store description is over 250 characters.
The `website_url` given is neither empty nor an http or https address.
No release of a dependency inside its range was given to pin.
A note, not an error: a disc archive dependency has no store form and stays in `s2u-pack.json`.
A required root file is not at the package's root.
The store `manifest.json` is not a UTF-8 JSON object within the manifest bound, or one of its keys breaks its rule.
The store manifest's name or version is not the pack's own.
`icon.png` is not a PNG of the required size.
